Union Trust Bank of India 
 Guarantee & Bond Department 
 
 
 Performance Bank Guarantee 
 
 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper - Value: INR 100/- 
 
 Bond No: BND-00117 Issue Date: 2021-10-08
 
 IRREVOCABLE AND UNCONDITIONAL 
 To: 
 The Managing Director / Executive Director 
 
 The Employer / Commissioner 
 India 
 
 Subject: Performance Bank Guarantee for Performance Bond - Tender Ref: RFP-132012416
 Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 WHEREAS National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (hereinafter called the "Contractor/Principal") has
 submitted a bid vide Tender Reference RFP-132012416 dated 2021-10-08 for the work of Bridges Flyovers
 Works, and 
 
 WHEREAS as a condition precedent for the award of the contract, the Contractor is required to furnish a
 Performance Bank Guarantee for 5% (five percent) of the contract value, and
 
 WHEREAS the Contractor has requested Union Trust Bank of India (hereinafter called the "Guarantor") to
 issue this Performance Bank Guarantee in your favour. 
 
 NOW THEREFORE, we, Union Trust Bank of India, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantee
 to pay to you, on first written demand without protest or demur, an amount not exceeding INR 52.14 Lakh
 
 (Rupees 52.14 Lakh Only), being Performance Bond amount, subject to the following terms:
 
 Terms and Conditions 
 
 1. Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed INR 52.14 Lakh (India
 Rupees Rupees 52.14 Lakh Only). 
 2. Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2021-10-08 until 2023-10-06 (the "Expiry Date")
 
 unless extended by mutual consent in writing. 
 3. Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or demand is
 served upon us on or before the Expiry Date. 
 
 4. Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our branch office
 at Mumbai or at any scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the claimant.
 5. No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no right of set-
 
 off, counterclaim, or defence arising from any dispute between the Contractor and the Employer.
 6. Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution, ownership,
 or control of the Contractor or the Employer.

Union Trust Bank of India
Guarantee & Bond Department

7. Governing Law: This guarantee is governed by the laws of India and is subject to the exclusive
 jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai.

 Date: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 
 
 
 Acknowledgement by the Contractor 
 I/We, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd., hereby acknowledge receipt of this Performance Bank Guarantee
 
 and confirm that the terms and conditions herein are acceptable. 
 
 
 
 Director 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 Date: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 
 
 
 Instructions to Bank (on expiry) 
 
 Bank should note that on expiry of the Bond Period, the Original Bond will not be returned to the Bank. The Bank is requested to
 take appropriate action on or after the expiry of the bond period. Any extension, if required, shall be communicated separately by the
 Guarantor.
